title: Desk Training Note: Open Enrollments per Prescription and Program Capacity in Auto Refill & Medication Sync
content:
**The rule.** A patient may enroll many prescriptions in Auto Refill & Medication Sync, each as its own enrollment. A prescription has at most one enrollment in enrolled, active or paused status at a time, whatever the program. Within any one program, the number of the patient's enrollments in that program in enrolled, active or paused status never exceeds that program's maximum number of prescriptions of one patient enrolled at once. No overall limit is set on the number of prescriptions one patient enrolls across the programs taken together.

## Questions the rule answers

**Which enrollments count as open?** Those in enrolled, active or paused status. An enrollment the patient has stopped (unenrolled) or that the program has ended (ended) is in neither status and counts toward neither limit.

**Does the one-enrollment limit depend on the program?** No. It applies across all six programs — Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day, Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day, Kestrel Med Sync Monthly, Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day, Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging and Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill. A prescription open in one of them is not open in a second at the same time.

**How is a program's count taken?** From the current state of the patient's profile: the patient's enrollments of that same program in enrolled, active or paused status are counted. Enrollments in other programs are not part of that count; each program's count is measured against its own maximum.

**Is there a ceiling across all programs combined?** No. The only counts that limit enrollment under this rule are the one-per-prescription limit and each program's own maximum.

## The two limits side by side

| Limit | What is counted | Ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| Per prescription | That prescription's enrollments in enrolled, active or paused status, in any program | One |
| Per program | The patient's enrollments of that one program in enrolled, active or paused status | The program's maximum number of prescriptions enrolled at once |
| Per patient across programs | — | None set |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

1. A hypothetical prescription holds a paused enrollment in Kestrel Med Sync Monthly. An enrollment of the same prescription in Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day would give it a second enrollment in enrolled, active or paused status, so that enrollment is not made while the paused one stays open.
2. A hypothetical prescription's only enrollment is unenrolled. That enrollment is not open, so the one-per-prescription limit does not stand in the way of a new enrollment of that prescription.
3. A hypothetical patient already holds, in Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging, as many enrollments in enrolled, active or paused status as that program's maximum. One more enrollment in that program would exceed its maximum and is not made. An enrollment of a different prescription in Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day is counted only against the Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day maximum.
